statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
